note: Demonstration settings used to write the expected Phase-1 results. None is a validated operating value; each is to be tuned per ranch. Class D = synthetic demonstration setting, C = ranch-specific management choice (docs/audit/data/rules-index.json legend). 'scenario assumption' marks a value the registries do not give; it was chosen here only so a fixture has one expected answer. These are the settings the folders were built with, before Phase 1. Where docs/audit/06-phase1-spec.md section 9 differs (24-hour drop formula, coverage minimum, individual gain interval, closed months), the setting carries a phase_1 note; 06 section 11.2 shows that none of these differences changes an expected row once decision D16's inputs are added.

settings.name: waterCriticalPct
settings.comparison: critical when the latest valid level < 25
settings.basis: RULE-WAT-01 (current value, demo setting)

settings.name: waterLowPct
settings.comparison: warning when the latest valid level < 40
settings.basis: RULE-WAT-02

settings.name: waterDropPts
settings.comparison: critical when (highest level in [last - 24 h, last]) - last level, rounded to 0.1, >= 30
settings.basis: RULE-WAT-03; window per WAT-03's proposed fix (02-findings.md 7.2 item 6 records the alternative); rounding per WAT-08
settings.phase_1: Phase 1 uses the maximum drawdown inside the same window (the largest fall from an earlier to a later reading; 05-roadmap.md decision D5, 06-phase1-spec.md section 5.2). Only the drawdown sees a fall that refilled inside the window (W-03: 40 points, where this formula gives 90 - 86 = 4). On these folders both give the same verdict for every tank (06 section 11.2).

settings.name: dropWindowMinReadings
settings.comparison: fewer than 2 valid readings in [last - 24 h, last]: the 24-hour change is CAN'T TELL ('not enough recent history'), the level is still judged
settings.basis: WAT-03 proposed fix; lead default 'bounded 24-hour drop window'

settings.name: sensorSilentHours
settings.comparison: serious when as_of - last reading >= 24 h; level and drop not judged
settings.basis: RULE-WAT-04 (measured against as_of)

settings.name: graceDays
settings.comparison: serious when days in pasture - planned_graze_days > 0; warning when it is between -2 and 0 inclusive ('due today' at 0)
settings.basis: RULE-GRZ-01, RULE-GRZ-02, UI-06

settings.name: plannedGrazeDays
settings.basis: RULE-GRZ-01 (the ranch's plan; class as in 06-phase1-spec.md section 9)

settings.name: adgSerious
settings.comparison: serious when pooled group ADG < 0.8 x target (strict)
settings.basis: RULE-GAIN-01; pooled sum(lbs)/sum(days) per GAIN-03 and GAIN-12

settings.name: animalShare
settings.comparison: warning when an animal's ADG < 0.5 x target (strict), only if the group is not already serious
settings.basis: RULE-GAIN-02, RULE-WF-19

settings.name: targetAdgLbs
settings.basis: RULE-GAIN-03, RULE-GAIN-04, RULE-GAIN-05, GAIN-13

settings.name: gainMinIntervalDays
settings.comparison: the two weigh sessions compared must be at least 21 days apart; used for the group and, in these fixtures, for the individual rule too
settings.basis: GAIN-03's example demo value. RULE-GAIN-07 recommends a separate 70-day individual default that the committed 57-day interval does not meet (02-findings.md 7.2 item 5); these fixtures do not adopt it
settings.phase_1: Settled by 05-roadmap.md decision D6: 21 days for the group, 42 days for individual animals (both demo settings, D). No change here: every judged pair in these folders is 57 days apart.

settings.name: weighSessionShare
settings.comparison: a weigh session is a date on which at least half of the group's head (groups.csv) crossed the scale
settings.basis: scenario assumption, from GAIN-03's 'dates when most of the group crossed the scale'

settings.name: gainMaxAgeDays
settings.comparison: CAN'T TELL when the group's latest weigh session is more than 45 days before the as-of date
settings.basis: GAIN-08 (demo limit)

settings.name: gainMinCoverage
settings.comparison: CAN'T TELL when animals weighed at both sessions / head < 0.5
settings.basis: scenario assumption; RULE-GAIN-10 and GAIN-07 call for a labelled minimum but give no number. In scenario 06 only 3 of 45 heifers (6.67%) were weighed on Sep 15, below the 23-head session minimum (weighSessionShare 0.5), so Sep 15 is not a heifer session and the heifers are CAN'T TELL on age (Jul 20 to Sep 30 = 72 > 45 days) at any coverage minimum. No folder tests gainMinCoverage
settings.phase_1: Phase 1 uses 0.8 (06-phase1-spec.md section 9, demo setting D). No folder changes: wherever a group is judged, every animal is matched (45 of 45, 150 of 150).

settings.name: dueSoonDays
settings.comparison: warning when 0 <= days to next_due <= 7 ('due today' at 0); serious when next_due is before the as-of date
settings.basis: RULE-HLTH-01, RULE-HLTH-02, UI-06

settings.name: healthStatuses
settings.comparison: any other value is a data issue and is treated as open
settings.basis: HLTH-01, RULE-HLTH-03

settings.name: budgetWarn
settings.comparison: warning when percent over >= 5% and dollars over >= $500
settings.basis: RULE-BUD-03 demo values; BUD-05 inclusive 5% bound

settings.name: budgetSerious
settings.comparison: serious when percent over > 10% (strict, as the rules table says 'more than 10%') and dollars over >= $1,000
settings.basis: RULE-BUD-03 dollar line; BUD-05 and the current rule text for the strict 10% bound. RULE-BUD-03's own formula says p >= 10%
settings.phase_1: Settled by 05-roadmap.md decision D2: serious needs more than 10% (strict) and at least $1,000, as here; scenario 09's Feed and mineral (exactly 10.0%) stays a warning.

settings.name: budgetLargeUsd
settings.comparison: warning when dollars over >= $2,500 whatever the percent
settings.basis: RULE-BUD-03

settings.name: unbudgetedUsd
settings.comparison: a category with a zero budget and spending >= $250 gives a warning in dollars, never a percent
settings.basis: RULE-BUD-06 (the dollars-only structure is a ranch choice, C; the $250 value is a demo setting, D, as in 06-phase1-spec.md section 9); severity 'warning' as in budget.materiality.research.mjs S4 (quoted in rules.json RULE-BUD-06 evidence)

settings.name: monthClosed
settings.value: a month counts when the ranch as-of date is on or after its last day
settings.comparison: as_of 2026-09-30T18:00 closes September
settings.basis: BUD-01 (assumption listed in findings.json unresolved_assumptions). RULE-BUD-05 and data-fields.json default books_closed_through to the month before as_of
settings.phase_1: Settled by 05-roadmap.md decisions D1 and D16: Phase 1 reads meta.csv books_closed_through (default: the month before as_of, labelled 'assumed'). D16 adds books_closed_through = 2026-09 to every folder dated 2026-09-30, which gives the same months as this convention; folder 08 (as of 2026-09-27) keeps none and so tests the default.

settings.name: ranchTimeZone
settings.comparison: meta.csv timezone for every new fixture; readings are ranch wall-clock time
settings.basis: TIME-02 (example zone); data-fields.json meta.timezone
